Q.IS NETBET CASINO LICENSED IN THE UK?

Yes, NetBet holds a UK Gambling Commission licence (account No. 39170). Regulated casinos must comply with strict rules in the UK to deliver a safe and fair experience for players. Safer gambling tools like deposit and time limits, secure payments, ID verification and more are essential for license holders.

Q.WHAT ARE THE BEST ONLINE CASINO GAMES?

The best game often depends on personal preference but at NetBet we have a variety of options to suit everyone. Slots are the most popular choice, with games like Golden Winner and Starburst standing out as favourites with our players. Blackjack or roulette are a good option for those after classic casino games and can be played instantly for a fast-paced experience or live for an interactive and immersive session.

Q.ARE ONLINE CASINO GAMES FAIR?

All games at licensed online casinos in the UK are independently tested by third parties to verify their fairness and the randomness of outcomes. The return to player (RTP) shows the expected return of a given game over a long period and is available for all of the titles at NetBet.

Q.CAN I WIN REAL MONEY PLAYING AT A CASINO ONLINE?

Yes. All real-money games offer the chance to win cash prizes, although outcomes are based on chance or game rules.

Q.HOW DO CASINO DEPOSITS AND WITHDRAWALS WORK?

To make a deposit or withdrawal simply log in and head over to the cashier. Here you can choose whether to deposit or withdraw, enter the amount and choose your preferred payment method. You can find more information in our payments section.

Q.HOW CAN I SET GAMBLING LIMITS OR TAKE A BREAK?

NetBet offers a range of safer gambling tools to help you stay in control.
